questions.prompt: You type /revenue Germany. The template says ${1:-all countries} in ${2:-the last 12 months}. What does pi send?
options: all countries in the last 12 months
questions.explanation: Germany fills $1. You typed no second word, so $2 uses its default, the last 12 months.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between a prompt template and a skill?
options: A template is chosen by the person, a skill by the model
A template is code and a skill is Markdown
A template is chosen by the model, a skill by the person
A template can hold arguments and a skill never can
questions.explanation: A person chooses a template by typing its command. The model chooses a skill by reading its description.

questions.prompt: A template file has no description in its front matter. What does pi show as its description?
options: The first line, cut to 60 characters
questions.explanation: Without a description, pi uses the first line of the file, cut to 60 characters.
